footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Edison International: after $242M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $2.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 9.8% to $19.3B in 2025. Operating income rose 2.4× to $7.1B, a 36.7% margin.
Net income rose 3.5× to $4.5B, or $11.55 per share. Operating cash flow was $5.8B and free cash flow −$715M, versus −$693M; Edison International returned $1.3B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Edison International Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
